nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 MCU (U3) serves as SPI master communicating with ADS1118 through digital isolators. SPI outputs (SCLK, CS, MOSI) drive through U4 and U5 to ADC. MISO receives ADC conversion data through U5. Powered from VCC_3V3 with ground on GND domain. BOOT0 pulled low for Flash boot. HSE crystal (8MHz typical) and NRST pull-up with filter capacitor required.
ARM Cortex-M3 MCU

nodes.name: isolator_spi_ctrl
nodes.description: ISO7721 dual-channel digital isolator (U4) for SPI clock and chip-select signals. Side 1 (non-isolated) powered from VCC_3V3/GND, Side 2 (isolated) powered from ISO_3V3/ISO_GND. Both channels pass signals from non-isolated to isolated side: SCLK_IN receives from MCU, SCLK_OUT drives ADC SCLK; CS_IN receives from MCU, CS_OUT drives ADC CS. Maintains galvanic isolation between GND and ISO_GND domains.
Dual-channel digital isolator

nodes.name: isolator_spi_data
nodes.description: ISO7721 dual-channel digital isolator (U5) for SPI data signals. Side 1 (non-isolated) powered from VCC_3V3/GND, Side 2 (isolated) powered from ISO_3V3/ISO_GND. Channel 1: MOSI_IN receives from MCU, MOSI_OUT drives ADC DIN (non-iso to iso direction). Channel 2: MISO_IN receives from ADC DOUT, MISO_OUT drives MCU MISO (iso to non-iso direction). Maintains galvanic isolation between GND and ISO_GND domains.
Dual-channel digital isolator

nodes.name: adc_isolated
nodes.description: ADS1118 16-bit SPI ADC (U6) on isolated side. Receives SCLK, CS, and DIN from MCU through digital isolators U4 and U5. Returns conversion data via DOUT through U5. AIN0 connected to VREF_5V precision reference for high-accuracy voltage measurement. AIN1, AIN2, AIN3 available for additional analog inputs. Powered from ISO_3V3 with ground on ISO_GND domain. Internal temperature sensor available via configuration register.
16-bit SPI ADC on isolated side
